fold: Senior clergy hold effective civic authority alongside elected aldermen; religious law shapes civil policy.
text: Senior clergy hold effective civic authority alongside elected aldermen; religious law shapes civil policy.
why: names 'elected aldermen' alongside the clergy; GOVERNMENT lists no elected body or aldermen, only the Ecclesiastical Council, Religious Authorities, War Council, Order of the Watch

fold: They operate in the shadow of Merchant oligarchy but not comfortably: they are waiting for a chance to push back.
text: They operate in the shadow of Merchant oligarchy but not comfortably: they are waiting for a chance to push back.
why: War Council 'waiting for a chance to push back' against Merchant oligarchy; QUARRELS has them symbiotic, stable, each needing the other

fold: Its seat is held by <N>, the watch commander and Lord Marshal.
text: Its seat is held by Manchu Hayashi, the watch commander and Lord Marshal.
why: 'Lord Marshal' for Manchu Hayashi, who is (f) in PEOPLE; the title does not fit her sex

fold: Arcane Council holds the seat and collects the taxes; Religious Authorities tell people that Arcane Council's rule is right and ordained.
text: Arcane Council holds the seat and collects the taxes; Religious Authorities tell people that Arcane Council's rule is right and ordained.
why: Arcane Council and Religious Authorities written as partners ('Each props up the other'); QUARRELS has them in open conflict over a council seat

text: The seatChan Uc, the senior guild master and Lord Mayor
why: 'Lord Mayor' for Chan Uc (f, senior guild master); GOVERNMENT lists no mayor, only City Council. Repeats at C07397

text: Merchant oligarchy gives the orders and War Council carries them out; each needs the other to stay strong.
